body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-04-28 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "we are on track to reach 450,000 tons per year capacity by June '26 ... This is a spillover from last year, which we were expecting to commission in March, but now that is extended till June." Metric: Second +75k t commissioning. Target: 450,000 MTPA. Deadline: 2026-06-30. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Next call (Aug-26) opening remarks: 'expected to become operational during the second half of the year', with no acknowledgement of the June date. In Q&A, 'only a few months deferment ... by the end of quarter 2'.
